name: Long Island Country Music Association
description: Nonprofit promoting country music and dance on Long Island; runs monthly western dances with DJ or band and lessons in Deer Park.
reviewNotes:
Town = where its dances are held (Brumidi Lodge); mailing address is a P.O. box in Commack.

Directory research 2026-10-04: No own venue: town = where the monthly dances are held (Sons of Italy / Brumidi Lodge, Deer Park); mailing address is a P.O. box in Commack, so no street address recorded. The 'Dance Instruction' page also shows licma85@gmail.com (apparently a second club address); not recorded. Logo is the round 'two boots' logo from the site header (800 px). Photos come from the club's own 2025 and home-page photo galleries. No Instagram/YouTube found.

evidence.note: About page: nonprofit, P.O. Box 0872, Commack, NY 11725-0872; info line (516) 775-5678; licma@licma.org.

Homepage: promoting country music and dancing on Long Island for over 40 years; a dance each month Sept-June with band or DJ and instruction; next dance Sat Oct 24, 2026, 7-11 PM, $20 ($15 members); links the licma.org Facebook page.
Contact page gives directions to the dances at the Sons of Italy Hall, 2075 Deer Park Avenue, Deer Park.
Brumidi Lodge event page 'Western Dance - LICMA' repeats the LICMA phone and email.
